title: IMO issues guidance on revised STCW refresher training intervals
summary: The International Maritime Organization published updated guidance clarifying that STCW Basic Safety Training refresher courses must be completed within 5 years of initial certification. Companies are advised to audit crew records before the next PSC season.

title: USCG announces expanded Port State Control examination focus for 2026
summary: The U.S. Coast Guard will prioritize fire safety systems, lifesaving appliances, and crew certification verification during foreign-flag cruise vessel examinations. Operators should complete pre-arrival checklists 72 hours before US port calls.

title: CDC VSP updates galley temperature monitoring requirements
summary: CDC Vessel Sanitation Program reminds operators that hot holding units must maintain 135°F (57°C) or above with continuous temperature logs. Recent inspections cited improper log maintenance as a recurring deficiency.

title: MLC amendments on seafarer hours of rest enter enforcement phase
summary: Flag states are increasing MLC compliance checks on hours of rest records and overtime documentation. Managers should verify that shipboard timekeeping aligns with collective bargaining agreements.

title: USCG NVIC reminder: advance Notice of Arrival required 96 hours before US calls
summary: Foreign-flag passenger vessels must submit NOA via NVMC at least 96 hours before arrival. Late or incomplete crew certification data may result in Code 17 deficiencies requiring rectification before departure.

title: Industry advisory: increased PSC detentions for expired firefighting certifications
summary: Multiple port states report detentions linked to expired Advanced Fire Fighting certificates among safety team members. Operators should run a fleet-wide certification audit within 14 days.
